# SHA256 source attribution

`native/app/sha256_backend.cpp` compiles the unchanged SHA256 implementation
from the pinned llama.cpp source at
`0a1ef309cdbb9f2024f58a38fb4c42352c5db569`, under
`vendor/hash/sha256/sha256.c`. Its original notice credits Igor Pavlov,
2010-06-11, and identifies the implementation as public domain. The source also
credits Wei Dai's public-domain Crypto++ implementation.

The C implementation and supporting rotate-bits header are read from the local
pinned dependency, not copied into this repository. Their source/license hashes
are included in native build provenance. The application glue carries its own
MIT notice; it does not replace upstream notices.
